we identified and mapped QTLs for shoot fly resistance component traits, leaf blade glossiness (QGLS10) and tricome density (QTD10), on sorghum chromosome SBI-10, which is a novel finding in sorghum genetics.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have identified QTLs for leaf blade glossiness (Qgls10) and seedling trichome density traits (Qt10) on sorghum chromosome SBI-10, which are associated with resistance to shoot fly.

the QTLs for leaf blade glossiness (QTL1) and trichomes density (QTL2) were mapped on the long arm chromosome 10 (SBIL10) in marker interval Xnhsbm1045–Xgap001 and Xgap001–Xtxp141 with 2.03–24.13 and 2.29–11.37 %, respectively.
QTLs for shoot fly resistance component traits glossiness and tricheome density have been mapped to a 2 Mb or 37–72 cm interval on SBI-010L.

QTLs for shoot fly resistance component traits can be mapped in a short interval on the sorghum genetic map.
